title: US Rule Set to Sharply Raise Cost of Canadian Drug Imports for Americans
detail: A new US rule is set to sharply raise the cost of Canadian prescription drugs for millions of Americans, representing a policy reversal on pharmaceutical imports. The change marks a significant shift from prior administration positions that had encouraged lower-cost drug imports from Canada as a way to reduce healthcare costs for American consumers.

title: US Accused of Exploiting Migrant Suffering Through Deportation Flights to Africa
detail: Human rights organizations accused the Trump administration of exploiting migrant suffering through deportation flights to Africa, drawing sharp criticism of the administration's immigration enforcement policy. Critics argued the flights subject deportees to dangerous and inhumane conditions, while the administration defended the removals as necessary enforcement of US immigration law.

media.caption: Deportation flights to Africa criticized by human rights groups
